author: Bryan Archuleta
text: The admins of this group haven’t been active in years, they may be dead now.

author: Steve Kuckuk
text: As a very old man who’s been online in various chat rooms and other forums going back well before the AOL days I have zero respect or interest in anyone posting anonymously… I seldom read their posts and I consider such posts rude… If someone doesn’t have the character to put their screen name on their words that they post online I just don’t care. If they want privacy, stay off-line then you’re completely private… At least that is the opinion I hold and have held for a couple of decades.
